recipes.title: Overnight oats in a jar
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Stir it together tonight; breakfast is waiting in the fridge tomorrow.
steps: Add the oats, milk, yogurt and cinnamon to a jar and stir well.
Top with the fruit, close the lid and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Stir and eat cold, straight from the jar. Add maple syrup if you like.
tips: Make 3 or 4 jars at once; they keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.
Swap the milk and yogurt for fortified soy versions to make it dairy-free.

recipes.title: Banana oat smoothie
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A thick, filling drink you can sip during a feed.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.
Pour into a cup with a lid and a straw.
tips: Freeze sliced ripe bananas so they're ready to go.
Use fortified soy milk and soy yogurt for a dairy-free version.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana milkshake
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Creamy, chocolatey and ready in two minutes.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend until thick and smooth.
Drink right away.
tips: Cocoa contains a small amount of caffeine; leave it out if you're keeping caffeine low.

recipes.title: Warm cinnamon vanilla milk
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A cozy, caffeine-free warm drink for night feeds.
steps: Warm the milk in a small pan or the microwave until steaming, not boiling.
Stir in the cinnamon, vanilla and maple syrup.
Pour into a mug with a lid and let it cool to a comfortable temperature.
tips: Use a lidded mug so you can sip safely while holding your baby.
Fortified oat or soy milk work well too.

recipes.title: Creamy oat porridge with peanut butter
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Warm, comforting oats with banana and a swirl of peanut butter.
steps: Add the oats and milk to a small pan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and top with banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.
tips: Microwave option: cook oats and milk in a large bowl for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.title: Veggie egg muffin cups
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Make a dozen on Sunday and reheat all week.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped vegetables (spinach, bell pepper, tomato)
Oil or cooking spray for the pan
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin pan.
Whisk the eggs, milk and pepper together.
Divide the vegetables and cheese between the cups, then pour in the egg mixture.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the eggs are firm and fully set in the middle, with no runny egg.
Cool, then refrigerate for 3 to 4 days, or freeze and use within 2 to 3 months for best quality.
tips: Reheat in the microwave for about 30 seconds until hot all the way through.
Leave out added salt if you'll share these with your baby, and cut a baby's portion into small pieces or thin slices.

recipes.title: Berry yogurt parfait
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Layers of yogurt, fruit and crunchy oats in five minutes.
ingredients: 2 tbsp rolled oats or toasted oats
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or jar.
Add half the berries and oats, then repeat the layers.
Drizzle with maple syrup if you like.

recipes.title: Avocado toast with egg
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A quick, satisfying breakfast with a fully cooked egg.
steps: Toast the bread.
Fry, scramble or boil the egg until the white and yolk are fully set.
Mash the avocado with lemon and spread on the toast.
Top with the egg and season.

recipes.title: Freezer breakfast burritos
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Wrap, freeze and microwave on busy mornings.
steps: Cook the pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the whisked eggs and scramble until fully cooked. Stir in the beans.
Divide the filling, cheese and salsa between the tortillas and roll up tightly.
Cool, wrap each one in foil or plastic wrap and freeze.
To reheat, unwrap, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until hot in the center.
tips: Frozen burritos are best used within 2 to 3 months. In the fridge, they keep 3 to 4 days.

recipes.title: Baked oatmeal squares
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A family-size breakfast that slices into grab-and-go squares.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease an 8-inch square pan.
Mix the oats, baking powder and cinnamon.
Whisk the milk, eggs and banana, then stir into the oats with the blueberries.
Pour into the pan and bake for 35 minutes, until set and golden.
Cool and cut into 9 squares. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 days, or freeze and use within 2 to 3 months for best quality.
tips: Ripe bananas sweeten it, so there's no need for added sugar.

recipes.title: Hummus veggie wrap
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Roll it up in five minutes and eat with one hand.
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Add the vegetables in a line down the middle.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.
tips: Hummus is made with tahini (sesame).

recipes.title: Chicken and quinoa salad jars
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Four lunches made at once, ready to grab from the fridge.
ingredients: 2 cups cooked chicken breast (cooked to 165°F), chopped
2 cups chopped cucumber and cherry tomatoes
steps: Cook the quinoa according to the package and let it cool.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and pepper in each jar's bottom.
Layer the chickpeas, vegetables, quinoa and chicken on top.
Seal and refrigerate for 3 to 4 days (salads like this don't freeze well). Shake into a bowl to eat.
tips: Halal and kosher depend on the chicken you buy; check the label.

recipes.title: White bean and tuna salad
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A no-cook, protein-packed lunch in ten minutes.
steps: Mix the tuna, beans, onion and tomatoes in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Stir through the parsley. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 days; tuna salad doesn't freeze well.
tips: Canned light tuna is on the FDA's "Best Choices" list for lower mercury. While breastfeeding, the FDA advises 2 to 3 servings (4 oz each) a week from that list.
Canned white (albacore) tuna is a "Good Choice" instead; the FDA advises no more than 1 serving a week of fish from that list.

recipes.title: Black bean and corn quesadillas
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A super-fast weeknight lifesaver: crispy, cheesy and ready in about 10 minutes.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 tbsp butter or oil for the pan
steps: Mix the beans, corn and salsa in a bowl.
Sprinkle cheese over half of each tortilla, add a scoop of the bean mixture, top with a little more cheese, and fold over.
Melt a little butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the quesadillas for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Cut into triangles and serve with sour cream or guacamole.
tips: Sharing with a baby or toddler? Whole corn kernels are a choking hazard; mash them with the beans or leave them out.

recipes.title: One-pot red lentil soup
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A big pot of warming soup that freezes beautifully.
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend partly or fully if you like it smooth.
Cool, then refrigerate for 3 to 4 days, or freeze in portions and use within 2 to 3 months for best quality.
tips: Use low-sodium or no-salt-added broth and tomatoes, and blend a plain portion if you're sharing with your baby.

recipes.title: One-pot turkey chili
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A mild, family-friendly chili for batch cooking.
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices, beans and tomatoes. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with rice. Refrigerate leftovers for 3 to 4 days, or freeze portions and use within 2 to 3 months for best quality.
tips: Halal depends on the turkey you buy; check the label.
Sharing with a baby or toddler? Mash the beans (whole beans are a choking hazard) and choose low-sodium or no-salt-added canned beans and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan lemon garlic salmon and broccoli
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Salmon, broccoli and peppers roasted on one pan with lemon and garlic. Zero messy pots.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Put the salmon and vegetables on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with the garlic, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Lay the lemon slices on top of the salmon.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes easily with a fork (145°F) and the broccoli is tender with crispy edges.
tips: Salmon is on the FDA's "Best Choices" list. While breastfeeding, the FDA advises 2 to 3 servings (4 oz each) a week from that list.
Sharing with a baby or toddler? Remove the skin, check carefully for bones, and flake the fish into small pieces.
Refrigerate leftovers and eat within 3 to 4 days.

recipes.title: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Fast, colorful and easy to adapt.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F. Set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic, soy sauce and chicken and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over rice.
tips: Most soy sauce contains wheat; tamari labeled gluten-free is an option.
Refrigerate leftovers and eat within 3 to 4 days.

recipes.title: One-pot tomato and spinach pasta
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Pasta and sauce cook together in one pot.
steps: Add the pasta, tomatoes, water, garlic and oil to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer, stirring often, for 10 to 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the Parmesan.
tips: Some Parmesan isn't vegetarian, halal or kosher (it may contain animal rennet); check the label.

recipes.title: Coconut chickpea curry
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A gentle, creamy curry that freezes well.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and curry powder.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk and tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve with rice.
tips: Sharing with a baby or toddler? Mash the chickpeas; whole beans are a choking hazard.
Refrigerate leftovers for 3 to 4 days, or freeze portions and use within 2 to 3 months for best quality.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker shredded chicken
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Ten minutes in the morning, dinner ready by evening.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken breasts or thighs
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with the spices.
Pour in the broth, cover and cook on low for 4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Shred with two forks. Use in wraps, rice bowls or salads. Refrigerate for 3 to 4 days, or freeze portions and use within 2 to 6 months for best quality.
tips: Halal depends on the chicken you buy; check the label.
For a baby or toddler, shred the chicken finely; tough or large chunks of meat are a choking hazard.

recipes.title: No-bake oat energy bites
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Grab-and-go bites, sweetened with dates.
steps: Mix everything in a bowl until it holds together (add a splash of water if dry).
Roll into 16 balls.
Refrigerate for up to a week, or freeze.
tips: Not for babies or young children: whole bites and chunks of nut butter are choking hazards.

recipes.title: Apple slices with peanut butter
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] The fastest snack with some staying power.
steps: Core and slice the apple.
Dip or spread with peanut butter.
tips: Not for babies or young children as is: raw apple pieces and thick peanut butter are choking hazards.

recipes.title: Cheese, crackers and fruit plate
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A no-cook mini meal you can graze on.
steps: Arrange everything on a plate or in a container with sections.
tips: Sharing with a toddler? Cut grapes into small pieces, slice cheese thinly instead of serving chunks, swap raw carrots for cooked soft ones, and skip crackers with seeds or whole grain kernels.

recipes.title: Classic tropical green
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A bright, fruity green smoothie with spinach, mango and pineapple.
steps: Add the coconut water and spinach to the blender first.
Blend on high for about 20 seconds, until the greens are completely liquefied.
Add the banana, mango and pineapple.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds, until completely smooth.
tips: Blending the greens with the liquid first gets rid of leafy bits.

recipes.title: Creamy avocado green
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Creamy and thick, with avocado, greens and chia to keep you full.
steps: Pour the almond milk into the blender, then add the greens, cucumber and apple.
Blend briefly to break down the greens and apple skin.
Add the avocado and chia seeds.
Blend on high for about 1 minute, until creamy and thick.
tips: Use any unsweetened milk you like, such as dairy, soy or oat, if you avoid nuts.

recipes.title: Cucumber ginger green
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A light, refreshing green smoothie with lemon, cucumber and fresh ginger.
ingredients: 1 cup cold water or coconut water
steps: Pour the water and lemon juice into the blender.
Add the ginger, cucumber, apple and kale.
Blend on high for about 60 seconds, until fully smooth.
tips: For a smoother, juice-like drink, pour it through a fine mesh strainer.

recipes.title: Matcha green tea smoothie
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A bright green, gently energizing smoothie with matcha, banana and hemp seeds.
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened soy or oat milk
steps: Add the milk, matcha and hemp seeds first so the matcha dissolves evenly.
Add the spinach and banana.
Blend on medium-high for about 45 seconds, until smooth and bright green.
tips: Matcha contains caffeine. If you're breastfeeding, count it toward your daily caffeine, and ask your provider if you're unsure how much is right for you.

recipes.title: Triple berry
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Sweet-tart strawberries, blueberries and raspberries, blended until smooth.
steps: Add the almond milk to the blender first.
Add the berries, fresh or frozen, and the banana.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds, until smooth.
tips: Use any unsweetened milk you like, such as dairy, soy or oat, if you avoid nuts.

recipes.title: Wild blueberry flax
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Thick and velvety, with wild blueberries, Greek yogurt, flaxseed and cinnamon.
steps: Add the almond milk and yogurt to the blender.
Add the flaxseed, cinnamon and blueberries.
Blend on high for 50 to 60 seconds, until velvety and thick.
tips: Use any unsweetened milk you like, such as dairy, soy or oat, if you avoid nuts.

recipes.title: Pomegranate acai
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A deep purple smoothie with acai, pomegranate juice and strawberries.
steps: Run warm water over the acai packet for about 5 seconds, then break it into chunks.
Pour the pomegranate juice and water into the blender.
Add the chia seeds, strawberries and acai.
Blend on high for about 1 minute.
tips: Choose pasteurized juice.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana protein shake
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Thick and creamy, with peanut butter, banana and protein powder.
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla protein powder (whey or plant-based)
steps: Pour the almond milk into the blender, then add the protein powder and peanut butter, so the powder doesn't stick.
Add the banana.
Blend on high for about 45 seconds, until thick and creamy.
tips: Check the protein powder label: many contain milk or soy. Supplements aren't reviewed by the FDA before they're sold, so look for one tested by an independent lab, and ask your provider if you're breastfeeding.

recipes.title: Chocolate hemp seed shake
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A chocolatey plant-based shake with hemp seeds, cacao and banana.
steps: Add the oat milk, cacao powder, vanilla and hemp seeds to the blender.
Add the banana on top.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds, until the hemp seeds are finely blended and the shake is smooth.
tips: Cacao contains a little caffeine.

recipes.title: Greek yogurt berry
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Rich and smooth, with Greek yogurt and mixed berries.
ingredients: 1/2 cup water or milk of your choice
steps: Add the water or milk, sweetener and yogurt to the blender.
Add the berries.
Pulse 3 or 4 times to crush the berries, then blend on high for about 45 seconds, until smooth.
tips: Never give honey to a baby under 12 months, even a taste.

recipes.title: Salted caramel date shake
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A sweet treat with dates, banana and a pinch of sea salt.
ingredients: 1 scoop vanilla protein powder (whey or plant-based)
steps: Chop or tear the dates into small pieces.
Pour the almond milk into the blender, then add the dates, protein powder and salt.
Add the banana.
Blend on high for about 60 seconds, until the dates are fully blended into a caramel-like shake.
tips: Check the protein powder label: many contain milk or soy.

recipes.title: Citrus sunshine
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A sunny orange smoothie with orange, mango, carrot and turmeric.
steps: Add the liquid, orange, carrot and turmeric to the blender.
Blend on high for about 30 seconds to break down the carrot.
Add the chia seeds and mango.
Blend on high for another 45 seconds.
tips: Fresh turmeric can stain, so rinse the blender right away.

recipes.title: Ginger turmeric pineapple
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Bright yellow and silky, with pineapple, banana, ginger and turmeric.
steps: Add the coconut water, ginger, turmeric and black pepper to the blender.
Add the pineapple and banana.
Blend on high for about 45 seconds, until bright yellow and silky.
tips: Black pepper is a classic partner for turmeric.

recipes.title: Golden milk tropical
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Rich and creamy, with mango, turmeric, cinnamon and kefir.
steps: Add the coconut milk, kefir or yogurt, turmeric and cinnamon to the blender.
Add the mango and banana.
Blend on high for 45 to 60 seconds, until rich and smooth.
tips: Use a coconut yogurt for a dairy-free version.

recipes.title: Papaya mint
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Light and refreshing, with papaya, fresh mint and lemon.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh or frozen papaya chunks
steps: Pour the coconut water and lemon juice into the blender.
Add the mint, chia seeds and papaya.
Blend on high for about 45 seconds, until smooth.

recipes.title: Pear cinnamon oat
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Thick and cozy, with pear, oats and cinnamon.
steps: Add the oat milk, oats and cinnamon first so the oats can soak up a little liquid.
Add the pear and banana.
Blend on high for about 60 seconds, until velvety.
tips: Use certified gluten-free oats if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Kiwi lime green
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Zingy and green, with kiwi, cucumber, spinach and lime.
steps: Add the water, lime juice, spinach and cucumber to the blender.
Blend on high for about 20 seconds.
Add the kiwis and blend on medium-high for another 30 seconds, so the seeds don't get crushed and turn bitter.

recipes.title: Blueberry oatmeal breakfast
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A thick, filling breakfast in a cup, with oats, blueberries and almond butter.
steps: Pulse the oats in the blender 5 times to break them into a coarse flour.
Add the almond milk, almond butter, banana and blueberries.
Blend on high for about 60 seconds, until thick.
tips: Use certified gluten-free oats if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Creamy almond fig
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Naturally sweet and creamy, with figs, almond butter and flaxseed.
ingredients: 3 dried or fresh figs, stems removed
steps: If using dried figs, soak them in warm water for 5 minutes to soften.
Add the soy milk, almond butter, flaxseed and figs to the blender.
Add the banana.
Blend on high for about 60 seconds, until smooth.

recipes.title: Tahini date
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Rich and nutty, with tahini, dates and banana.
steps: Chop the dates into small pieces.
Add the oat milk, tahini, dates and hemp seeds to the blender.
Add the banana.
Blend on high for 60 to 90 seconds, until the dates are completely smooth.

recipes.title: Turkey taco skillet
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Taco night flavor in one pan, with turkey, black beans and corn.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Brown the turkey in a large skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked, 6 to 7 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the beans, tomatoes with their juices, and corn. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes until heated through.
Sprinkle the cheese over the top, cover for 2 minutes until melted, and top with cilantro.
Serve with avocado or whole-wheat tortillas.
tips: Cook chicken and turkey to 165°F.
Check the taco seasoning label if you avoid gluten.
Sharing with a baby or toddler? Whole corn kernels are a choking hazard; mash them or leave them out.

recipes.title: Lemon herb chicken and asparagus
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Golden chicken and tender-crisp asparagus in a bright lemon-garlic pan sauce.
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, cut into cutlets or bite-size pieces
1 bunch thin asparagus, trimmed and cut into thirds
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper and oregano and cook for 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the asparagus to the pan. Sauté for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pour in the lemon juice, scraping up the browned bits.
Return the chicken, toss in the pan juices, and top with lemon zest.
tips: Cook chicken and turkey to 165°F.

recipes.title: Creamy spinach and tomato gnocchi
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Comfort food made fast: soft gnocchi in a creamy garlic, tomato and spinach sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream or canned coconut milk
steps: Cook the gnocchi in boiling salted water as the package directs, usually 2 to 3 minutes, and drain when they float.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté the garlic and tomatoes for 3 minutes, until the tomatoes start to burst.
Stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts, about 1 minute.
Add the gnocchi and parmesan and stir until coated in a creamy sauce.
tips: Most gnocchi contain wheat; check the label.
For dairy-free, use olive oil and coconut milk and skip the parmesan.

recipes.title: Ground beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Better than takeout: savory ground beef and broccoli in a glossy ginger-soy sauce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water
steps: Brown the beef in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until cooked through. Drain extra fat if needed.
Add the garlic, ginger, broccoli and 2 tbsp water. Cover for 3 minutes to steam the broccoli until bright green and tender-crisp.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey and cornstarch mixture, pour it in, and stir for 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Drizzle with sesame oil. Serve over rice or cauliflower rice.
tips: Cook ground beef to 160°F.
Use tamari labeled gluten-free if you avoid wheat.
Sharing with a baby? Never give honey to a baby under 12 months.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato tortellini soup
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A cozy, creamy tomato soup with cheese tortellini and spinach that kids tend to love.
ingredients: 3 cups low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
1 can (28 oz) crushed or diced tomatoes
1/2 cup heavy cream or cream cheese
steps: In a medium pot, combine the broth, tomatoes, garlic, Italian seasoning and a pinch of salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Add the tortellini and cook as the package directs, about 4 to 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Ladle into bowls and top with parmesan.
tips: Use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweet potato chili
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A cozy plant-based chili with black beans, sweet potato and warm spices.
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced small
2 cans (15 oz each) black beans, rinsed and drained
steps: In a medium pot, cook the onion and sweet potato in the oil for 5 minutes, until the onion is translucent. Dicing the sweet potato small helps it cook quickly.
Add the chili powder and cumin and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the beans, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the sweet potato is fork-tender.
tips: Freeze leftovers in portions for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Coconut curry chickpea soup
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A fragrant, creamy chickpea soup with coconut milk, curry and spinach.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat the oil in a soup pot over medium heat. Sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 to 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk and broth. Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach just before serving, until wilted.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan sausage and pepper hash
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A hearty, low-prep dinner of crispy potatoes, sausage and peppers on one pan.
ingredients: 4 chicken or turkey sausage links, sliced into rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.
Add the sausage, peppers and onion. Drizzle with the rest of the oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Toss and roast for another 15 minutes, until the potatoes are crispy and the sausage is browned.
tips: Cook chicken or turkey sausage to 165°F, unless the package says it's fully cooked.
Check sausage labels for allergens and gluten.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan honey mustard chicken
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Sweet and savory chicken tenders and green beans, all on one pan.
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size tenders
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Whisk the mustard, honey, oil and garlic powder in a small bowl.
Put the chicken and green beans on a baking sheet, pour over the sauce and toss to coat.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the beans are tender-crisp.
tips: Cook chicken and turkey to 165°F.
Sharing with a baby? Never give honey to a baby under 12 months.

recipes.title: Mediterranean tuna pita pockets
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] No-cook tuna salad with yogurt, cucumber, tomato and feta, stuffed into pitas.
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz each) light tuna in water, drained
steps: Flake the tuna in a medium bowl with a fork.
Stir in the yogurt, olive oil, salt and pepper until creamy.
Fold in the cucumber, tomatoes and feta.
Stuff into warmed pita pockets.
tips: Canned light tuna is on the FDA's "Best Choices" list. Albacore (white) tuna is a "Good Choice": have no more than 1 serving a week.

recipes.title: Teriyaki chicken rice bowls
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Chicken, vegetables and brown rice in a glossy teriyaki sauce.
ingredients: 2 cups precooked or microwave brown rice
2 cups mixed stir-fry vegetables, such as snap peas, carrots and broccoli
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Add the vegetables and 2 tbsp water. Cover for 3 minutes to steam.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and simmer for 2 minutes, until glossy and thick.
Serve over warm brown rice.
tips: Cook chicken and turkey to 165°F.
Most teriyaki sauce contains soy and wheat; check the label.

recipes.title: Garlic butter shrimp pasta
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Feel fancy with minimal effort: shrimp and pasta in a lemony garlic butter sauce.
ingredients: 1/4 cup chicken broth or pasta water
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water as the package directs. Save 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Set the shrimp aside.
Add the broth and lemon juice to the pan, scraping up the browned bits.
Toss in the pasta, shrimp and reserved pasta water until coated. Top with parsley.
tips: Shrimp is on the FDA's "Best Choices" list.

recipes.title: Creamy mushroom pasta
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Vegetarian comfort in a flash: golden mushrooms in a creamy parmesan sauce.
ingredients: 8 oz button or cremini mushrooms, sliced
1/2 cup heavy cream or cream cheese
steps: Cook the pasta as the package directs and drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the mushrooms for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and their liquid has evaporated.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cream and parmesan and simmer for 2 minutes, until creamy.
Toss in the pasta until well coated.

recipes.title: Pesto chicken and tomato penne
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A pantry-shortcut dinner with jarred pesto, rotisserie chicken and cherry tomatoes.
ingredients: 2 cooked chicken breasts, shredded or diced (rotisserie chicken works great)
steps: Cook the penne as the package directs. Save 2 tbsp pasta water, then drain.
Off the heat, toss the pasta in the warm pot with the chicken, pesto, tomatoes and reserved pasta water.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve right away.
tips: Many pestos contain pine nuts, other nuts and cheese; check the label.

recipes.title: Spinach, tomato and feta frittata
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] A protein-packed, low-prep frittata with spinach, tomatoes and feta.
steps: Heat the oven broiler to high.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Cook the tomatoes and spinach for 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts.
Pour in the eggs and sprinkle with feta. Cook without stirring for 5 minutes, until the edges set.
Broil for 3 to 4 minutes, until golden, puffed and set in the middle.
tips: Cook until the center is firm, with no runny egg.

recipes.title: Huevos rancheros bowls
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Bold flavors from pantry staples: eggs, black beans, salsa and avocado on warm tortillas.
steps: Warm the beans in a small pot.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
In the same skillet, fry the eggs in a little oil.
Put a tortilla in each bowl and top with beans, salsa, avocado and a fried egg.
tips: Sharing with a baby or toddler? Cook their egg until the white and yolk are firm.

recipes.title: Naan margherita pizzas
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Friday-night pizza made fast on store-bought naan.
ingredients: 4 pieces store-bought naan, garlic or plain
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Lay the naan on a baking sheet and spread each with a few tablespoons of sauce.
Top with mozzarella and tomatoes.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Top with basil and slice.
tips: Many naans contain milk and egg; check the label.

recipes.title: BBQ chicken flatbread
recipes.summary: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] Sweet, savory and effortless, with rotisserie chicken, red onion and melty cheese.
ingredients: 2 large flatbreads or premade pizza crusts
1 cup shredded cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken works great)
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella and gouda cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken with half the BBQ sauce.
Spread the rest of the sauce over the flatbreads and top with the cheese, chicken and onion.
Bake for 8 to 12 minutes, until the crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbly. Top with cilantro.
tips: Check BBQ sauce labels: some contain fish (in Worcestershire sauce) or honey.
